item: Write-gate holds: the backlog drain commits at a hold target or when a writer queues, and a long hold says its length when it ends
key_paths: src/analytics/store.py; src/backup/merge.py; src/api/backup_v2.py; src/database/writer.py; tests/test_reindex_hold_target.py; tests/test_write_gate_release_line.py
summary: The backlog drain (the re-index of imported articles that resumes at every boot) commits a batch early: reindex_articles takes should_flush(staged, held_s), asked after every staged article, and the drain hands it reindex_flush_policy, which answers True once the batch has held the single-writer gate for OO_REINDEX_HOLD_TARGET_S seconds (default 10, 0 = the old count-only rule, an unreadable value keeps the default) or another writer is queued behind it (WriterGate.waiters). The batch width stays the ceiling, the floor is one article, and a policy that raises is dropped for the rest of the call. The drain re-reads the target per batch and publishes it with batch_commits, early_batch_commits and longest_batch_s. The gate also writes one line when a hold of the watchdog threshold or more ends, "write gate released after N s by 'name'" (thread name and seconds only), because the watchdog's own figure is the moment it noticed the hold, not its length. Measured on a synthetic store (600 articles, plain and SQLCipher, a second writer asking every 0.1 s, about a fifth of the field's hold lengths): width 200 holds the gate 7.9 s plain and 6.0 s encrypted and the arriving writer waits exactly that; width 50 holds 2.0 s at no measurable apply cost; width 10 holds 0.8 s and costs 17 to 39 percent more apply time (a commit is about 0.1 s here); an age of 2 s on width 200 cut the longest hold from 7.9 s to 2.3 s, and a rare writer behind the default policy waited 0.3 s. Not measured: the field machine's commit time, a real UI save as the arriving writer. The 2,415 s longest wait of the 30 Sep crash is NOT explained; it waits for the next zip from the long run. 30 mutants of the policy, the pass and the drain wiring and 8 of the release line are killed by the new tests.
